finalists.label: Inverted Papilloma
finalists.why: It has the most specific and detailed evidence for its diagnosis, including a cystic mass occupying the left fronto-ethmoid region with destruction of the anterior skull base and erosion of the left lamina papyracea.

finalists.label: Nasal tumor
finalists.why: It has a broad range of evidence supporting its diagnosis, including a mass at the level of the left middle turbinate extending into the left nasal roof and eroding the upper nasal septum, an expansile, mildly enhancing soft-tissue mass in the anterosuperior nasal cavity, and a cystic mass occupying the left fronto-ethmoid region with destruction of the anterior skull base and erosion of the left lamina papyracea.

finalists.label: Invasive fungal sinusitis
finalists.why: It has some evidence supporting its diagnosis, including a mass at the level of the left middle turbinate extending into the left nasal roof and eroding the upper nasal septum and an expansile, mildly enhancing soft-tissue mass in the anterosuperior nasal cavity.

frontier_selector.why: The champion, Inverted Papilloma, is chosen because it has the most specific and detailed evidence for its diagnosis, including a cystic mass occupying the left fronto-ethmoid region with destruction of the anterior skull base and erosion of the left lamina papyracea, which is not shared with other finalists.
